profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hi, I'm Shannon! I am a highly collaborative, self-motivated and adaptable software engineer with 5+ years of experience across multiple industries. I'm a generalist engineer who thrives on solving complex problems across the entire stack. I specialize in building scalable, datadriven systems and user-centered applications, with a track record of owning high-impact features end-to-end and collaborating effectively across product, data, and design teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Helped migrate EasyPost’s FedEx service from a legacy SOAP implementation
to an extracted REST one (Python),
Delivered multiple net-new, end-to-end API features for EasyPost’s core product
including surcharge detail, pickup requests and address verification for users
Contributed to a custom, yaml-based test suite for the FedEx service, increasing tested code
coverage to +90% and identified key bugs and gaps
Implemented, maintained and improved observability metrics for the FedEx and
UPS microservices using Grafana, Kibana and DataDog

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Founding member of the EditShare Front end UI team, responsible for building a from-scratch modern single-page app for EditShare’s media asset management products. Designed and developed novel UI’s (VueJS, React, TS) and reusable component library. Worked closely with Product & Design to ensure high quality features delivered on time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented backend microservices and RESTful API’s (Python, Docker) for complex enterprise distributed storage product. Wrote unit tests (Pytest), helped maintain home-grown automated test suite, and performed QA testing, triage and bug fixing regularly. Wrote bash scripts for process automation.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: Masters candidate in computer science at Tufts University focusing on data visualization and human-computer interaction research.
positions.insights: Skills: C · C++ · Python · User Research · Prototyping · D3.js · Data Visualization · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineering Research Intern
positions.description: Built multiple prototypes for ongoing research projects in the Cyber Systems & Operations Group for the military at a national lab. Implemented multiple different machine learning models (Python) and visualization methods (D3JS, Python) for improved anomaly and threat detection. Ran user experiments, analyzed data and co-authored subsequent research papers. Published  research and presented at international computer science conference (IEEEVis)
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Machine Learning · D3.js · Research

positions.title: Data Visualization Developer
positions.description: Skills: Tableau · JavaScript · D3.js · Python · Amazon Redshift · Adobe Creative Suite
